entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTACH-NEEDED
entities.description: A substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED where valid subscriber data are available for the UE and an attach must be performed as soon as possible.

entities.name: Access class blocked due to access class control
entities.description: Condition where the UE's access class is blocked preventing network access.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection establishment rejected
entities.description: Condition where the network rejects the establishment of a NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Attach must be performed as soon as possible
entities.description: System behavior requiring immediate attach procedure execution when valid subscriber data is available.

relations.description: Access class blocking condition can lead to entering the ATTACH-NEEDED substate.
NAS connection rejection condition can lead to entering the ATTACH-NEEDED substate.
Being in ATTACH-NEEDED state establishes the requirement to perform attach as soon as possible.
